Frequently Asked Questions

How does laundry pickup work?

Book online, choose a slot, and our team collects from your address. (Sample policy; the business must confirm its real process.)

How long does laundry take?

Regular laundry typically takes 24–48 hours, subject to service availability. Dry cleaning and premium care may take longer.

Is pickup and delivery free?

Free for orders above ₹499; otherwise a ₹49 fee applies. (Sample rule.)

Can you clean silk and zari sarees?

Yes, through our Saree Care service, usually with dry cleaning and gentle steam pressing. Results depend on fabric age and condition; the business should confirm its handling limits.

Do you handle delicate clothes?

Yes, via Premium Garment Care and Dry Cleaning. Results depend on fabric condition; the business should confirm its handling limits.

How can I cancel or reschedule an order?

Contact us before pickup by phone or email. (Sample policy; confirm the real cancellation window.)

How do I track my laundry order?

Order tracking needs a backend and is not part of this single-file demo. A future version would ask for your booking reference and registered mobile number.
